title: Polynomial size under DAG conversion
statement: Let $C$ be a family of Boolean circuits indexed by input length. If there are natural numbers $a$ and $k$ such that, for every $n$, the size of $C_n$ is at most $a(n+1)^k$, then the family of directed acyclic graph circuits obtained from $C$ has polynomial size: there are natural numbers $a'$ and $k'$ such that every circuit at input length $n$ has size at most $a'(n+1)^{k'}$.
